Name: Hasshub
Summary: Father of Shemaiah the Levite, son of Azrikam son of Hashabiah.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 9:14: Father of Shemaiah the Levite, son of Azrikam son of Hashabiah.
LifeLesson: The mention of Hasshub in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
